title: Leave only the ligand visible
prompt: Load cellular retinoic-acid-binding protein II (1CBS) and hide the protein and the waters so that only the bound retinoic acid is shown.

provenance.derived: Replaces the July task, which was the prompt's worked example word for word. 1CBS has exactly three default components: polymer, ligand (REA) and water.

notes: Tests hide_polymer, which no July task used.
